items.reason: Modernized Java runs on standard JVM ASCII/UTF-8 character collations.
items.impact: Non-numeric sorting order differs from mainframe EBCDIC binary representations.
items.required_action: Review business rules dependent on EBCDIC collation (e.g. letters preceding numbers) and configure custom Java Comparators if required.

items.source_pattern: EXEC CICS READ DATASET(...), WRITE DATASET(...), STARTBR
items.reason: Direct CICS dataset file operations are currently unsupported in online transaction contexts.
items.impact: Emits CICS_UNSUPPORTED_COMMAND diagnostic at parse time.
items.required_action: Map dataset access to Spring Boot Data repositories or CobolIndexedFile runtime helpers.

items.source_pattern: EXEC CICS SYNCPOINT across DB2 and MQ/IMS
items.reason: Distributed 2PC transactions across heterogeneous mainframe resources are unsupported.
items.impact: Atomicity across multiple data sources cannot be guaranteed without an external transaction manager.
items.required_action: Consolidate into single-resource relational transactions or adopt Saga / Outbox patterns.
